statement: Ordinary relative pro-reconstruction, with pinned underlying limit map, for every characteristic-zero field of finite transcendence degree.
Transcendental scalar transitions need not be pinned; the full model system is not an object of Pro(pinned topoi).
The infinite-transcendence ordinary pro problem is resolved by B.PRO1--5; the shorter finite-transcendence proof alone did not cover it.
A rational formal arc without any nontrivial algebraic valuation-preserving self-correspondence exists, by finite elimination and countable avoidance.
A countable henselian discretely valued field K=Q(t,u)^h of transcendence degree2, residueQ and valueZ has trivial centralizers in Aut(barK) at every finite extension.
Supported infinitesimal scaling gives compatible log-special-fibre isomorphisms for all finite marked genus-zero models, including arithmetic cusp data.
Étale reconstruction fails over every equicharacteristic-zero henselian discretely valued field, by a pinned nonalgebraic affine-line topos autoequivalence.
The all-finite-extension centralizer condition does not imply reconstruction; a recursively specified transcendence-degree-two henselian field is a counterexample.
The specific field K_*=Q(t,sum t^(n!))^h left open in AS-FF.18 fails reconstruction.

All finite-transcendence-degree residue-zero henselian fields now fail reconstruction; exact remaining B8 scope consists of mixed-characteristic cases, notably maximal metabelian B_p and unbounded towers outside earlier decided classes.
The maximal solvable closure of K_p=Frac(Z_(p)^sh) equals Qbar and fails reconstruction; this does not settle B_p or the lower-central union.
The metabelian field has exact stable radical Kummer kernel W_p and W_p intersect(1-W_p)=F_p; two wild p-Kummer comparisons exclude supported scaling as an actual pinned autoequivalence.

For the union of all fixed nilpotency-class strict-local fields, every finite extension has rational p-Kummer kernel exactly roots of unity when p>=5. At p=2,3 explicit nontorsion elements have all p-power roots in the union. This does not settle reconstruction.
For p>=5, if an actual value b in any finite extension of the lower-central union satisfies kappa(b)=alpha*kappa(p), then alpha is rational.

For p>=5, every pinned relative affine-line topos autoequivalence over a finite extension of the lower-central union has a unique affine actual geometric point function; the full pointwise automorphism kernel and arbitrary morphisms remain unresolved.

dependencies: Kummer corestriction and norm residue formula
statement: Over finite extensions of the lower-central union at p>=5, a p-Kummer class on a punctured smooth curve with actual values at all finite-extension points has rational boundary residues.

dependencies: elementary harmonic-function computation and Cauchy estimates
statement: Every pinned relative affine-line topos morphism over a finite extension of the lower-central union at p>=5 has a unique polynomial actual point function; this is not yet equality of full inverse-image functors or arbitrary-source reconstruction.
